segment.description: Big Bigby Creek (GNIS 01305201, HUC-8 06040003), the major west-bank Duck River tributary draining Maury County through the Columbia area - NOT Little Bigby Creek (separate GNIS water, TDECWPC-LBIGB004.1MY) and NOT the stocked McCutcheon Creek winter-trout water in Columbia. Agency monitoring spans the whole creek: USGS 03601500 'AT CROSS BRIDGES' (upper), USGS 03601100 'AT NEEDMORE' (middle), USGS 03600500 'AT SANDY HOOK' (lower), and TDECWPC-BBIGB008.5MY / 014.0MY / 016.3MY river-mile stations.
segment.boundaries: Catalog: 'Major Maury County tributary in the Duck River basin' - full course within Maury County from the Cross Bridges headwater country to the Duck River confluence below Columbia (NHD reachcodes 06040003xxxx).

coldSource.notes: Un-dammed Western Highland Rim agricultural/residential creek. Four agency stations over four decades record June-September water temperatures of 20.5-31.0 C - no cold-water mechanism exists in the record.

holdover.detail: No trout presence of any kind is documented, so no holdover question arises. TWRA has never stocked this creek: the 2026 row-level schedule contains zero Bigby rows (the only trout rows in Maury County are McCutcheon Creek winter stockings), and the Trout MASTER layer returns zero Bigby sites.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found; TWRA's trout regulations page (fetched 2026-09-18) contains zero Bigby entries - no special regulation, no wild-trout listing.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: Four agency stations (USGS 03600500/03601100/03601500 + TDECWPC-BBIGB008.5MY) record 20.5-31.0 C June-September temperatures across 1966-2008, and no trout stocking, regulation, or occurrence is documented for the creek anywhere.

sourcesChecked: repo-local: packages/content/data/twra-stocking-schedule.json (owner-supplied 2026-09-17 TWRA workbook) - ZERO rows matching 'Bigby' in any county; the nearest Maury Co. trout program is 'McCutcheon Creek' (Winter, 1/23/2026, 2/20/2026, TBD 12/2026) which is a different Columbia water (adjacency trap avoided). Catalog stockingProgram is false.
